verification.validation: Patch checks cover bounded audit overflow without file writes, exact approved read classification, ordering and rotation, failed/partial append recovery, concurrent flush, sysfs wake detection, private bounded tmpfs staging, native bridge staging and readback ownership. Relevant Go packages run with the race detector, vet and builds; canonical payload builds generate the six executor/lifecycle digests with the pinned Go toolchain. Both npm packages are built and packed for content scans. Documentation, version, timeout and manifest checks are included. No full gate matrix, qemu, publication or NAS hibernation acceptance is implied.

changes: Buffer classified read-only delegated WebAPI audit in a bounded memory ring; overflow drops oldest events and emits a single dropped:N marker at the next real flush.
Flush only when all system-array members are known awake, before durable audit or on graceful stop. Keep mutations synchronous and directory synchronization limited to creation or rotation.
Stage read and download output only in private bounded tmpfs and consume it without creating persistent staging. Legacy native bridges require executable memory and are prepared once at startup.
Document crash loss of unflushed read audit, conservative unknown-method classification, tmpfs capacity limits and the coordinated App runtime/executor rebuild.
